prompts.tilda: Use case: identity-preserve. EDIT the first image, Tilda's existing painted game portrait, using image 2 (her pixel NPC) for garment colors. The current portrait resembles another woman in a green hood; redesign Tilda into a clearly DISTINCT village wool-spinner in her late thirties. Give her a warm olive complexion, a broad square face with a strong jaw and wide cheekbones, a straight substantial nose, dark hazel eyes, scattered freckles, and a confident lopsided friendly smile. Chestnut wavy hair in a short thick bob with a distinct side part, showing generously around the temples. A SMALL fitted sage-green cloth working cap sitting on the back/top of the head with a narrow band, ears and cheeks uncovered; this is NOT a hood and must not drape around face or shoulders. Keep the russet wool lace-up bodice and cream blouse from her NPC, no white apron, no neck shawl. Preserve the existing warm detailed painted medieval RPG style and right-facing three-quarter bust with complete shoulders/upper arms, safe transparent margins on all sides. Do not copy the original face. Real transparent background, no text, no border. Output a single square 1024x1024 portrait.
prompts.edwinSprite: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: production pixel RPG NPC idle sprite sheet for Emberfell. Image 1 is STYLE/PROPORTIONS reference only: the existing chibi NPC. Create ONE NEW farmer named Edwin, middle-aged man with sun-browned warm tan skin, short dark brown curls, a thick dark brown moustache and clean-shaven chin, a broad weathered face, low woven straw hat with a moss-green hatband, golden-ochre plain waistcoat over cream shirt with sleeves rolled to elbows, dark olive trousers and brown work boots. Friendly stout working man. Match reference pixel shading, huge readable head, compact sturdy body, slightly overhead RPG camera. EXACT 4 columns by 4 rows, 16 separate fully contained sprites with generous transparent gutters. Square canvas 1024x1024. Every logical cell 64x64 enlarged4x with crisp square pixels; complete body about54 logical pixels tall, boots baseline atlogical y60, consistent scale and placement. Rows: row1 SOUTH front; row2 NORTH back; row3 EAST profile looking right; row4 WEST profile looking left. In EACH row the FOUR columns are neutral open eyes, tiny one-pixel cloth breathing change, half blink, closed blink. Preserve fixed head, hat, face, boots, body registration; breathing only cloth, no bouncing or shrinking. Back row no face and closed collar on back. Both feet fully visible within each cell, no cropped toes. Do not add tools, animals, floor, shadows, background, labels, grid lines, or any text. Genuinely transparent alpha. 16-bit hand-pixelled game art, crisp edges, not painted or soft. Exactly16 poses.
prompts.edwinPortrait: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one transparent painted dialogue portrait for new Emberfell farmer Edwin.
